builds.hypothesis: R3 is(650+AD[statFormula=2])*(1+0.3*critChance*(critDamage-1)); explicit crit-stat scaling justifies IE and100% item crit, with armor penetration for physical mitigation. IE supplies75AD,25% crit and30% crit damage. Collector/Essence Reaver/Lord Dominik reach100% item crit with IE. Bloodthirster adds80AD; Hubris has exactly10 credited kills. Same-patch practice/custom test with exact state: record Ace in the Hole tooltip, observed AP/AD/HP/mana/resists, per-packet damage/protection and final targetHP. Compare one legal item swap at a time, separating setup damage, rune/item procs and ordinary attack. Isolate the named ability/passive packet from item procs, rune damage and the rest of the combo. Record raw versus post-resistance damage, actual crit outcome, charge, rank and target state. Healing/shield/execute thresholds are separate metrics, not damage.

Use the stated benchmark, not free infinite stacks or allied buffs. The initial form fields are editable defaults (level18, target3000HP/100armor/50MR); adjust them and record every other requirement before measuring.
failureConditions: The candidate loses the intended packet gain after real mitigation, charge restrictions, proc behavior or buff eligibility is measured.

tradeoffs: Six final items explicitly replace late-game boots; slower access/escape, extreme cost and setup dependence. Raw-number candidate sacrifices practical positioning and does not prove a global maximum.
Confidence: plausible. This is a finite-condition ceiling candidate, not a solver-certified global maximum or a recommended match build.
buyOrder: This is a late six-item ceiling loadout. Compare individual item swaps at fixed level, earned stacks and target conditions; the displayed order is not a lane shopping order.
Keep boots and role starters during the actual game. A damage-slot boot replacement requires a deliberate late benchmark and may make the ability impossible to land.

kitEvidence.formula:
Caitlyn takes a moment to channel and line up the perfect shot, then she fires, dealing [(300 / 475 / 650 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]) × ((1 + ((0.3) × Stat(8)) × (((1) × Stat(9) + -1))))] physical damage, but other enemy champions can intercept it. This Ability grants True Sight of the target during the channel.

Damage scales with Caitlyn's Critical Strike chance and Critical Strike Damage.
